answer: Documented unmet needs for palbociclib (Ibrance) include: (1) lack of clear overall survival benefit, as PALOMA-2 final analysis showed no significant OS difference vs letrozole alone (53.9 vs 51.2 months, HR 0.956); (2) safety/tolerability burden, with ILD/pneumonitis risk requiring discontinuation, and dose reductions/modifications in 38.4% and permanent discontinuation in 5.2% of patients due to adverse reactions; (3) diminished real-world efficacy in later-line settings, where median PFS dropped to 7.8 months versus 22.8 months first-line; and (4) immature OS/payer value data for newer maintenance indications. These gaps may warrant discussion with Medical Information for further nuance.
